name: skadis-air-repo
description: The repository's npm workspace: the geometry library and the page

scripts.check:stl: npm run build -w skadis-air && node scripts/checks/write-sample-boards.mjs && bash scripts/checks/stl-check.sh .check/boards/*.stl
scripts.test-plate: npm run build -w skadis-air && node scripts/test-print/write-test-plate.mjs && bash scripts/checks/stl-check.sh .check/test-print/skadis-coupon-seam.stl
scripts.trial-plate: npm run build -w skadis-air && node scripts/test-print/write-trial-plate.mjs && bash scripts/checks/stl-check.sh .check/test-print/skadis-trial-grips-keyhole.stl
scripts.printables: npm run build -w skadis-air && node scripts/printables/write-files.mjs && bash scripts/checks/stl-check.sh .check/printables/*/*.stl
scripts.grams: npm run build -w skadis-air && FILAMENT="${FILAMENT:-PETG Basic NPETG087-ZX}" node scripts/checks/write-board-grams.mjs
scripts.plates: npm run build -w skadis-air && node scripts/test-print/write-test-plate.mjs && node scripts/test-print/write-trial-plate.mjs && node scripts/printables/write-files.mjs
